reviews.title: Beautiful, Comfortable, and Worth It — Just Keep It Clean
reviews.comment: I absolutely love this keyboard! From the moment I started using it, the quality really stood out—it feels sturdy, well-made, and not cheap at all. The keys have a soft, satisfying feel with great response, and best of all, it’s quiet, which is perfect for working in shared or quiet spaces. The comfort and ergonomics are a huge plus. I can type for long periods without any strain, and everything feels very natural. The size is perfect too—not bulky, but still fully functional with all the keys I need. Speaking of functionality, it’s been reliable and super easy to use. I haven’t tried the Bluetooth connectivity since I always use the included USB receiver—and it works flawlessly for me every time. Now let’s talk about the pink color—because it’s beautiful, but it does need care. From what I read in other reviews, it can stain easily. The key is simple: clean it daily or every other day to keep it looking brand new (check out my video!). I’ve had mine since late December and it still looks like new thanks to this cleaning kit (it even includes a microfiber cloth): 🧼 Cleaning Kit: https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0CPGPFW5Q Directions: Using the cleaning solution included in this kit, lightly spray onto the microfiber cloth—avoid spraying directly onto the surface. Gently wipe in circular motions without applying heavy pressure. Finish by buffing dry with a clean, dry section of the microfiber cloth. Also, avoid using hand lotion or hand sanitizer before using the keyboard. If you’re willing to maintain it, this keyboard is 100% worth it. Stylish, comfortable, and functional—you’re welcome 😎
reviews.author: Nathaly

reviews.title: Compact keyboard
reviews.comment: This compact keyboard is perfect for my ergo desk. Working from home my regular keyboard takes up too much room in my keyboard tray. This one is just the perfect size and allows me to keep my ergo mouse right nice to it with my elbow on my side and relieves some pain due to a bone spur on my elbow. Great wireless connection.  It’s a little pricey but so worth it. I even got the skin to protect it from dust if water spills. The keys are not as loud as a regular one. Great quality!
reviews.author: Lucy Gerardo

reviews.title: Best keyboard I've owned
reviews.comment: I have been using this keyboard for work and personal use for 2 days and am loving it so far. It's perfect for my needs and here's why: 1. It has all the functions I need and then some 2. It's just the right size. I was using a separate keyboard for my personal pc than for my work laptop and the other keyboard is much larger, not leaving much room for my mousepad in the desk tray. 3. It connects seamlessly to both, my laptop and desktop so I don't even have to use the other keyboard now! I wasn't looking for that but is a HUGE plus now that I have it setup. You can save 3 connected devices and switch between them using F1, F2, and F3. This was a huge help since I use the same monitor for both devices (I bought an hdmi splitter for that) but would have to use 2 different keyboard/mouse each time I switched. Now I only use 2 different mouses (mice?) which I'll probably upgrade as well. 4. The keys have good response without being noisy. You can hear them, which I prefer, and feel the feedback, also preferred, but you don't have to press hard and don't get the loud click-clack of old school keyboards. 5. It's comfortable to use, at least for me. The palm rest cushion is soft but seems like it will hold up for a long time. The major keys are reachable without lifting my palm and there was minimal adjustment from my much larger keyboard. 6. Very easy setup (I use Windows...can't speak to Mac, Google OS, etc.). As soon as I turned on the keyboard, it paired with my laptop. I had to do absolutely nothing for setup (see note below). The ONLY very small con I have is that it doesn't tell you anywhere in the packaged instructions that you can pair multiple devices. I knew this from another reviewer. Even then, I had to search how to do it, because it's not obvious on the Logitech website. Once I figured it out, it was very easy to do (have your laptop/pc/whatever search for bluetooth devices and hold down the button F1/2/3 button that you want to assign to that device. The device will then discover the keyboard and you're good to go). Other Notes: I would recommend this keyboard to anyone. It's pricier than other keyboards I've bought but I didn't add a con for that because I believe it's definitely worth it. You can change how the function keys work using their application and even setup "smart actions" which will do a bunch of stuff like opening your favorite apps and a bunch of other stuff. All of this stuff is configurable too, although, I haven't tried to use it yet. I just needed a keyboard so I didn't have to use my laptop keyboard but got many features I didn't even know I needed! Get this keyboard!
reviews.author: Matt B

reviews.title: Logitech Wave Keyboard
reviews.comment: I’ve been using the Logitech Wave Keys for about three weeks now, and overall I’m impressed. My wrists definitely feel more comfortable thanks to the built-in cushioned palm rest and the wave-shaped layout that keeps my hands in a more natural position. According to reviews it “felt immediately natural and comfortable to use”. The wireless connectivity is smooth — I’ve paired it via Bluetooth and also used the Logi Bolt receiver without much fuss. The key noise is very quiet, which is great for shared office spaces. That said, there are a few things worth noting: Because of the ergonomic/wave layout, the key spacing and overall footprint feel a little more compact and “different” than my old keyboard. It took me a few days to adjust. One review noted “the layout is a bit cramped and may take some getting used to.” There is no backlighting, and in lower-light conditions I sometimes find myself squinting to see the legends. The keyboard uses replaceable AAA batteries rather than a rechargeable built-in battery. It’s fine, but I would’ve preferred USB-C charging.
reviews.author: David

reviews.title: Say hello to my new friend
reviews.comment: I absolutely love this ergo mini keyboard is how I describe. Not only is it a space saver and very aesthetically  appealing, but also I believe it has improved my key stroke. I was always placing my fingers wrong on the flat keyboard and misspelling very often.  I still use one finger to reach numbers and other far away keys but I think it is a vast difference and easy to learn. I originally purchased a #1 rated redo key board which appeared so daunting compared to this one. It also took up a bit of room on my limited desk space. This ergo min is very lightweight, easily portable and matches well with the color of my HP desktop. The real work is right around as my classes start soon and I’ll be spending sleepless nights on my computer. This keyboard is the one saving grace that helps eliminate some anxieties.  I’ll let you know in the future how goes it. Right now if you’re willing to try something new, this is a good purchase and worth the price. I also purchased the ergo mouse partner, and true to advertisement claim, it is as quiet as a mouse. Literally.  And set up did not stump this dummy for long. A quality keyboard, quality mouse, quality purchase.
